description: An engineering manager must publish a four-week incident-commander rotation for the platform team, assigning a primary and backup for each week after the normal scheduling review.

shared_context.S1: The next incident-commander rotation covers four weeks, beginning on the first Monday of next month.
shared_context.S2: Each week must have one primary incident commander and one different backup, and Maya publishes the binding schedule.
shared_context.S3: The team's scheduling template uses primary order A1, A2, A3, A1 and backup order A2, A3, A1, A2 for weeks 1 through 4.
shared_context.S4: When a template assignee is unavailable, the next available person in roster order A1, A2, A3 is used; a backup that conflicts with the resulting primary is replaced by the next person in that same roster order.
shared_context.S5: Before Maya publishes the rotation, the team follows its normal practice of confirming leave, qualification, and handoff requirements in the scheduling review.

PF1.text: Theo's approved leave record covers all of week 2. He noticed it while processing an unrelated leave request this morning, but the scheduling spreadsheet has not been updated yet.

PF2.text: Rina confirmed with the incident-response coordinator today that the week 4 database exercise requires her to be the primary incident commander and Theo to be the backup because they are the only pair qualified for that exercise; she has not added the qualification note to the scheduling review yet.

acceptance_conditions: The published schedule must assign A1 primary and A2 backup in week 1.
Because A2 is unavailable in week 2, the schedule must assign A3 primary and A1 backup in week 2.
The standard week 3 template assignment must remain A3 primary and A1 backup.
The week 4 exercise must assign A3 primary and A2 backup.
The schedule must contain a leave-update commitment for A2's week 2 absence.
The schedule must contain a qualification-handoff commitment for the week 4 exercise.
Both private facts must be cited in the manager's justification and revealed by their owners.

content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'leave_update' and c['target'] == 'A2' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] == 'qualification_handoff' and c['target'] == 'week4' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Theo's week 2 leave changes the primary from the template's A2 to A3, changes the conflicting backup from A3 to A1, and requires the A2 leave-update commitment.
The week 4 exercise qualification changes the primary to A3 and the backup to A2, and requires the week 4 qualification-handoff commitment.
